Scenario: Predictive Credit/Insurance Risk Model Governance and Continuous Monitoring
Human Agents: Risk & Compliance team member; Model validator/internal auditor; Data scientist/model owner; Human risk overseer
AI Agents: Governed predictive ML model; OpenScale-derived monitoring engine (Quality/Fairness/Drift monitors); LIME/SHAP explainability sub-agent
Goals: Maintain a compliant, fair, and accurate predictive model in production satisfying MRM standards and audit requirements
Human Tasks: Configure monitor thresholds and group definitions; review documented model iteration history for audit; retain oversight of automated retraining
AI Tasks: Compute Quality/Fairness/Drift/Explainability metrics on schedule ('Evaluate now'); generate LIME/SHAP explanations; trigger retraining workflow on threshold breach
Capabilities: Fairness/bias detection; drift detection; explainability computation (LIME, SHAP); quality/accuracy monitoring; automated workflow triggering
Context: Regulated banking/insurance environment; decisions affect credit access, insurance pricing, AML alerts; subject to MRM standards and audit requirements
Inputs: Training data; payload (live prediction) data; feedback (ground-truth outcome) data
Outputs: Quality/fairness/drift/explainability scores and alerts; dashboard insights; documented model iteration history
Interactions: Human risk-oversight review of automated retraining triggers; data-scientist configuration of monitors; dashboard review by risk/compliance staff
Decision Points: Whether a monitored metric breaches threshold; whether to trigger automated retraining; whether model passes audit/validation review
Feedback Mechanisms: Production feedback data recalculates drift/quality; automated retraining triggered by monitoring results with human oversight retained
Evaluation Metrics: Disparate Impact (80% default threshold); Statistical Parity Difference; model accuracy/quality score; drift score; LIME/SHAP explanation outputs

Goals: Deploy a generative AI assistant with relevant, faithful (low-hallucination), and safe outputs
Human Tasks: Create and compare prompt-template assets; configure evaluation experiment; map validation-data columns; review Factsheet-logged results before promotion
AI Tasks: Execute LLM-as-a-Judge scoring across candidate models/prompts; compute NLG task metrics; monitor live inputs/outputs for HAP/PII/quality
Capabilities: RAG-quality assessment; content-safety screening; multi-vendor model integration; LLM-as-a-Judge comparative evaluation; automated Factsheet generation
Context: Multi-vendor generative AI deployment; enterprise customer-facing or internal knowledge-work setting with hallucination/unsafe-content risk
Inputs: Prompt templates with variables; validation datasets (questions/contexts/reference answers); production input prompts and generated outputs
Outputs: Comparative evaluation scores and weighted rankings; AI Factsheet entries; production monitoring alerts
Interactions: Developer-in-the-loop comparison among LLM/prompt candidates; conversational onboarding assistant; reviewer sign-off on Factsheet results

Feedback Mechanisms: Production input/output data fed back into evaluation and Factsheet update; experiment results inform iterative refinement
